move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you very much for your offer for the stainless pump shaft SH-220, and for your kind words about building a long-term partnership. We appreciate the care you put into your proposal.

We would like to suggest two packages for your consideration:

- Option A: EUR 14.98 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau
- Option B: EUR 14.83 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau

Both options include delivery to our site in Hollerau, so each side knows exactly what is expected. Option B gives you faster payment in return for the slightly lower price.

To help us understand your offer better, could you send us your cost breakdown for this part?

We look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your constructive proposals and are pleased to build upon Option B, as the 14-day payment term is highly agreeable to us.

We can accommodate the requested DAP delivery and 35-day lead time; however, the inclusion of freight and logistics requires an adjustment from our initial EXW pricing. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Consequently, we propose a unit price of EUR 16.50 for this package.

To summarize, our offer includes a price of €16.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your thoughtful reply, and for taking up the 14-day payment term so readily. We appreciate the care you have put into working with us on the SH-220 shaft, and we understand that including freight and logistics changes your cost picture.

We would like to keep our price where it is and offer you a choice of two packages:

- Option A: EUR 14.98 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP Hollerau
- Option B: EUR 14.53 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW

Option B leaves the freight with us, so you can stay with your original EXW basis.

We would also value your view on one point: is there a variant of the part or the process that would be cheaper for both of us? We would be glad to look at any idea together.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Our adjusted Angebot comprises a price of €15.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, and delivery EXW. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding a cheaper variant, our engineering team will gladly review the drawings to suggest potential design-to-cost optimizations. We are eager to build a strong partnership and look forward to moving this project forward together.

- Option B: EUR 15.39 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Hallo, I saw the other quote, but we need a fair price to keep the machines running. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. 

Our offer is a price of €15.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW.

As an alternative, I can do 16.10 EUR for the DAP delivery with 14 days payment, having a price of €16.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.56 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.37 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.23 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. I'll ask the guys in the shop if there's a cheaper way to machine this part and get back to you.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH
